title: Knight Eats Queen
setup: The white king sits on h1 behind two pawns, and its rook on d1 is defended only by the queen.
hint: Nothing forks yet. Ask which white piece you can force onto the square where a fork would appear.
explanation:
## The Idea

Your knight's fork square is f2, hitting h1 and d1, but the queen on c2 guards it, so the immediate hop just drops the knight. {{Rxd1+}} is check, and {{Qxd1}} is forced, so the queen now stands on one of the fork's targets. {{Nf2+}}, {{Kg1}} is forced, and {{Nxd1}} wins the queen: you were a queen down, and now the material is level.

When a fork square is guarded, drag the guard onto one of the fork's targets.
